messages:
incidents-bot: :rotating_light: INCIDENT 2890012345 — Elevated tail latency observed for /v1/generate in us-west-2. p99 breaching SLO (target 2s). Streaming stalls and client-side timeouts reported. Auto-paged oncall.

maria: I'm on it. Graphs look rough — p95 ~1.2s, p99 ~5.7s right now. Streaming stall count spiked at 22:04 UTC.

devon: Confirmed. kv_cache.evictions per-min jumped ~3x at 22:04. Paging-to-disk metrics show multiple page-in spikes (~200ms median). Could be fragmentation + churn on large prefix keys.

aj: Any increase in 5xx? are clients seeing errors or just stalls?

maria: No notable 5xx surge, mostly delayed chunks which cause some client timeouts and retries. ~8% of requests affected in the last 10m, concentrated on long-prefix interactive sessions.

devon: Quick dump from runtime nodes:
```
# tail 500 /var/log/runtime/evictions.log | jq '.msg, .metrics'
kv_cache.evictions_total: 3452
kv_cache.paging_rate: 120/s
kv_cache.mem_frag_ratio: 1.38
```
Looks like many small allocations and hot churn on keys that blow up KV shard occupancy.

aj: Hypothesis: prefill path is causing big writes into the KV cache concurrently with decode reads, producing lock inversion / thrash. Prefill-heavy traffic + high-cardinality prefixes => fragmentation and paging storms.

maria: Proposed mitigations (quick):
- disable prefix prefill for model-x in us-west-2
- reduce runtime batch size from 64 -> 32 for that pool
- short-term routing: divert non-critical traffic to model-x-quant variant
- monitor evictions/paging and revert flags after stabilization

deploy-bot: deploy-bot: feature flag change prepared. Will apply when given ok.

maria: I'm going to flip the runtime flag for pool-usw2-model-x: `RUNTIME_PREFILL=false` at the pool level. Rolling to 100% over 3m.

devon: Also start reducing batch size on that pool: `kubectl set env ds/runtime-pool-usw2 MODEL_BATCH=32` — be careful, might change throughput.

aj: I'll add a temporary routing rule in the router to send 30% of non-PLG traffic to model-x-quant for 30m. That should reduce new prefill load.

maria: executing flag now.

deploy-bot: feature flag RUNTIME_PREFILL=false applied to pool-usw2-model-x by maria at 22:12 UTC. Rollout 20% -> 100% in ~3m.

devon: evictions down within ~4m of flag flip. kv_cache.evictions per-min back to baseline. p99 dropped to ~1.6s, streaming stall events down ~70%.

aj: Good. Customer impact: support queue shows 3 live reports from customers with interactive apps in last 15m (IDs: C-104, C-221, C-309). Support notified.

maria: Handoff: @aj you're primary for next 2 hours to watch the pool and routing. I'll draft the postmortem when stable.

aj: Ack. Routing rule active for 30m; I'll remove after 30m if metrics remain stable. Created temporary PagerDuty note.

devon: I'll own the writeup. Initial notes: root cause likely KV cache fragmentation driven by high-cardinality prefill writes + locking behavior in prefill path that amplified memory pressure and forced paging. Action items: safer prefill backpressure, per-request prefill size cap, improve LRU compaction, telemetry to expose key-cardinality by customer.

support-bot: customer-notify: support notified customers C-104, C-221, C-309 with initial incident blurb.

incidents-bot: INCIDENT 2890012345 — mitigated at 22:30 UTC. p99 returned under 2s and streaming stalls reduced to baseline. Please open INC-2026-456 for full writeup and postmortem. :white_check_mark:
